rules.title: A contest of movement and occupation
rules.description: Two sides cross the pink Arena, capture by hopping and return prisoners through exchanges. Fill all six cells of the opposing building to win.

goal.title: Six-cell victory
goal.body: The Suffragettes aim for the House of Commons; Police aim for Albert Hall. Fill all six cells of the opposing building.

horse.title: Steps and hops
horse.body: Move one empty cell in any direction, or chain hops over one adjacent piece and land on the empty cell beyond.

center.title: Arena captures
center.body: Captures occur by hopping over an enemy in a pink Arena cell. Small pieces capture diagonally; large officers capture in any direction.

reply.title: Prisoners and exchanges
reply.body: Captured Suffragettes go to Prison; captured Police go to Hospital. Once both hold twelve, either player can exchange up to six matched pairs.

endings.title: Digital endings
endings.body: Threefold repetition is a draw and no legal move is a loss. These endings are product conventions; the printed rules do not specify them.

footer.note: An original digital adaptation of the documented second-edition rules.
